correctness.rationale: For each H-vertex orbit, its support on the set of parts is precisely a full H-orbit of parts. Thus invariant faces form a blown-up weighted threshold complex, with contiguity reduction to one vertex per group. Edge cases empty fixed locus, contractible case, S0 wedges handled. 124 finite tests corroborate without replacing symbolic proof.
